acceptance_evidence: The shared schema contains every required dated horizon and valuation-basis field.
Each output class has an independent status and permission boundary.
Legacy target-price and return scalars remain null in schema 5.1.0.
All six controlled modules produce the same shared output contract.
Forward FCF and forward shares are recalculated by validators.
Unsupported or unselected modules do not fall back to manual forward FCF.
Schema 5.1 production migration now materializes DRIVER_MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE instead of silently omitting S10.
Incomparable peer rows are suppressed for negative denominators, period mismatch, currency mismatch, definition mismatch, source mismatch, or failed recalculation.
Reverse valuation uses dated authoritative capital evidence.
Independent DCF inputs and sensitivity are evidence-bound and reproducible.
Probability-weighted return remains unavailable unless both probability governance and S09 return eligibility validate.
Controlled business-model cases validate driver models, forward shares, scenarios, and valuation-language boundaries.
One-sided method support cannot upgrade RANGE_ONLY.
S11 multi-method support without a complete S09 horizon cannot exceed PARTIALLY_VALIDATED.
Five preserved public-company contracts pass the actual schema 5.1 production semantic and final-validation path without synthetic valuation backfill.
No formal target price, portfolio action, or position size is produced from incomplete evidence.

promotion_fix.finding: A legacy public-company contract upgraded through the shared schema 5.1 semantic path could omit forward_valuation_contract instead of stating the unsupported-model outcome.
promotion_fix.root_cause: The shared migration function materialized S09 and S11 contracts but assumed S10 had already been built by the fresh-company builder.
promotion_fix.system_wide_fix: The shared migration function now builds the S10 contract when it is absent or lacks a contract version.
promotion_fix.regression_coverage: Five public-company contracts across consumer brand, retail, software, transportation, and industrial fixtures now exercise the production migration and finalizer.

scope_boundaries: Full MULTI_METHOD_VALIDATED acceptance cases use clearly labeled synthetic fixtures to validate shared mechanics; they are not public-company research or investment conclusions.

The five preserved public-company contracts validate safe production migration and no-input fallback. They do not contain newly invented analyst forecasts, peer sets, probabilities, or independent DCF assumptions.
The initial S10 registry does not cover every business model. Unsupported models must return DRIVER_MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE until a shared module is designed and tested.
Gate 4 portfolio context, Partner Internal Return, position sizing, portfolio action, and trade execution remain disabled or separately governed.
Phase C infrastructure validation does not claim that stored CROX, AZO, CRM, ODFL, or ITT market data is current for a new investment decision.
